jobs.description_text: Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform.

Reporting to the Head of Communications, SAMEA, you’ll work closely with regional leadership and Spotify’s global communications teams across consumer, corporate, policy, industry, executive, and internal communications. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution and knows how to navigate culturally dynamic, fast-moving markets.

In this role, you’ll drive demand capture and retention for Premium India by localising global strategies, developing India-specific initiatives, and executing across conversion funnels, offers, lifecycle programs, and win-back initiatives. You’ll collaborate with global and regional Growth teams as well as local Marketing and Music teams, while owning execution and experimentation in India.

In this role, you will sit at the heart of the music ecosystem, moving between high-level release strategies and the day-to-day tactical execution that drives artist and business growth. This role is perfect for a music industry professional who thrives on building relationships and navigating the intersection of technology and creativity. Our ideal candidate has fun at work and a desire to make a positive impact on the music industry as a whole. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape.

Sitting at the intersection of marketing, product, music, and strategy, the team works closely with Music, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to grow Premium through cultural relevance and artist-led initiatives. In this role, you’ll own Premium desirability and the artist and partner Premium flywheel for India, shaping how we work with artists, cultural moments, fandom, and partnerships to drive Premium consideration and measurable conversion at scale.

Spotify reports indirect taxes in more than 90 countries globally and you will be a key member of the team responsible for ensuring the completeness, timeliness and accuracy of Spotify’s global indirect tax compliance obligations. You will work in close collaboration with global tax team members in both Stockholm and New York, and work cross functionally with various accounting and finance teams. We are a team of highly skilled and dedicated colleagues and we offer a challenging and dynamic role in an ever changing environment with the opportunity to take on much responsibility in a rapidly growing international company. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

jobs.description_text: Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. About Quotient Therapeutics
Quotient Therapeutics is a Flagship Pioneering company that uses somatic genomics to discover drug targets. We use high-accuracy sequencing to find rare somatic mutations in cells from non-cancerous diseased human tissue. Mutations that help cells survive or expand in a disease environment point to causal biology. We use that evidence to nominate and assess targets, and to decide whether a target should be copied (protective mutations) or opposed (disease-driving mutations).

The Role
Quotient is seeking a (Senior) Scientist, Machine Learning to build models and AI agents that turn our somatic mutation data into evidence for target discovery. A central question is what a given mutation does to a protein, and whether that effect explains why cells carrying it are selected in disease. You will build models of variant effects on protein function and connect them to genomic, single-cell, perturbation and phenotype data. You will also develop agentic AI workflows that help scientists analyse data, test hypotheses and make decisions.
